create_mixer_upgrades.ponder.mixer_upgra: Upgrade Kits let a Mechanical Mixer run its recipe many times in a single cycle
Right-click the Mixer with a Kit to install it
Each tier runs up to 16, 32, 48 or 64 recipes per cycle. Installing a new Kit hands the old one back
With the Blazing Kit, one cycle turns 64 sets of ingredients into 64 results
The batch stops early if the Basin runs out of ingredients or output space
Sneak and right-click with an empty hand to take the Kit back out. Breaking the Mixer drops it too
